_comment: FORBIDDEN input — model trying to store a raw prompt body or log. This is rejected by redaction_check() before any storage. The claim and summary fields must not contain raw request bodies. The tool schema forbids raw_prompt, raw_request_body, request_body, full_log, telemetry_event, stream_event as top-level fields via additionalProperties:false. Even if claim content looks like a log, redaction_check() should surface a warning if it detects obvious raw content patterns.
_rejection_reason: raw_prompt is a forbidden field (redaction_check). The claim must not be a raw request body, prompt blob, or telemetry event.
